categories.label: Weight Loss
categories.blurb: Participants who noticed changes in weight, bloating, body shape, or how their clothes fit.

categories.label: Energy & Clarity
categories.blurb: Improved focus, feeling lighter, clearer thinking, or renewed motivation.

categories.label: Digestive Reset & Cleansing Experience
categories.blurb: Feeling less heavy, more balanced, less sluggish, or generally “cleaner” through the program.

categories.label: Lifestyle Reset
categories.blurb: People who valued the structure of the program and the break from unhealthy habits or overconsumption.

categories.label: Overall Experience
categories.blurb: The program as a whole, including ease of use, satisfaction and general wellbeing.

disclaimer: These are individual experiences shared by participants. Results and experiences vary from person to person.

testimonials.name: Tanya
story: Wow, what an invigorating experience. I would highly recommend this to anyone wanting to rid the body of built-up toxins and waste.
I experienced much clearer clarity of mind and an amazing boost of energy.
And what a bonus to lose 7kg in 10 days.
Incredible... I can't wait to do it again!

testimonials.name: Mark Gibbons
story: I found it hard to lose weight and detox through exercise and other fad diets, so I thought I would give the Lemon Detox Diet program a go. That decision has changed my life.
I decided to detox for 7 days and started out at 120kg. After an easy 7 days I dropped 9.3kg, weighing in at 110.7kg.
I look and feel 110% better by losing that weight and cleaning out my system with the detox.
I'm so happy with the results that I'm ready to do another 7-day detox already as my ultimate goal is to reach below 99kg.

testimonials.name: Anissa Carrodus
story: I have done the lemon detox twice and will definitely do it again. I thought it would be much harder, but after the first day or two I don't even miss food!
I was expecting to feel lethargic, but after staying on the detox for 7 days I feel fantastic, and more alert.
There is also the bonus weight loss. I lost 8kgs in 7 days.
It is undoubtedly the best detox I have ever done and would recommend it to everyone!

testimonials.name: Larry V Cassidy
story: My name is Larry Cassidy and I am a professional jockey. I moved to Brisbane two years ago from Sydney where I won three Sydney Jockeys Premierships. Last season I won the Brisbane Jockeys Premiership and am currently running third this season. I have also ridden successfully overseas in Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan, Macau, Malaysia and Korea.
I have been using the Lemon Detox program for the last three years, on and off. A jockey's weight is very important in their career and I have struggled with mine since moving to Queensland.

For the last three months I have been using the Lemon Detox program through the week and my weight is the best it's ever been. I am getting to the races with loads of energy and in a better frame of mind, where before I was dehydrated, drained and lethargic — you do not want to be like this when you're riding a 500kg animal.
With my weight being more under control I believe that I am riding better than I ever have.

testimonials.name: Les Cameron
story: Hi, my name is Les Cameron. I have just finished 20 days on the Madal Bal Lemon Detox program and dropped 18kg.
I have done detox programs in the past and found them very hard, but I found the Lemon Detox program very easy and had no hunger pains at all.
During the program I walked two hours per day and drank around 4–5 litres of water daily.
I now have much more energy and wake up around 6:30–7:00am every day feeling fresh and clear-headed.
I recommend the Lemon Detox program as I now feel like a new person, and I look forward to using it again alongside my diet.

testimonials.name: Jodie Ross
story: I used the Lemon Detox program for one week and lost 5kg. I was totally amazed with the results.
I felt great, had more energy, and there was definitely a spring in my step. My skin also looked clearer.
It wasn't hard to stick to the program. In fact, I developed quite an affinity for the lemon and honey drink and still enjoy it quite frequently.
As far as detox programs go, I have been recommending this one to everybody I know — especially after the indulgence of the silly season.

testimonials.name: Suzanna Kralevski
story: It is wonderful!
I detoxed for 7–10 days and lost 9.5kg. I have never looked back since. I feel and look a million dollars, with my weight now at 52kg.
I recently fitted into a beautiful Mariana Hardwick gown that I purchased 10 years ago (size 8). My husband and everyone who saw me were, for the first time in 23 years, speechless.

I now have more energy than when I was 25 years old. I have taken up dancing and running, and both my husband and I have met an entirely new group of wonderful and exciting people thanks to the Lemon Detox Diet program. I am now feeling and looking great.
My husband is so impressed with my excess energy and renewed enthusiasm for life that we are planning to purchase the Lemon Detox again so that he can complete the program as well.
The hardest part was getting through the first day, but once you do, by the third day you don't want to get off it.
I have recommended it to all my family and friends and to anyone who wants to feel good and look their best.

testimonials.name: Prudence Adama
story: Thanks to the Lemon Detox Diet program I lost 6kg in one week before Christmas.
Before I started the Lemon Detox program I was wearing a size 14, and now I am back to my size 10.
I feel great. I have always struggled to stay on a diet, but I have to admit that the Lemon Detox program is the best and quickest way I have found to lose weight.
It sounded hard when my friends first told me about it, but once I started it was actually very easy, and I really enjoy the taste of the syrup.
Thanks once again — I wouldn't have done it without it and I'm already planning to purchase more.

testimonials.name: Daniel
story: I was preparing for a trip and wanted to lose some extra weight after a long winter. I started the Lemon Detox Diet program after a recommendation from a colleague.
As someone who normally eats large meals, I was surprised at how easy it was to switch to a liquid program — I rarely felt hungry.
I experienced a slight drop in energy around day two, but by the next day my energy levels were back to normal.
I completed 9 days initially and lost 7kg. After a short break, I returned to the program for another week and lost a further 4kg.
In total, I went from 113kg to 102kg in under 4 weeks, even with minimal exercise.
I was also able to maintain my weight between phases, which was a great result.
I wouldn't have tried this without a trusted recommendation, but it really works.

testimonials.name: Susie
story: A friend of mine told me about the Lemon Detox Diet, so I purchased a tin and started straight away.
I had a headache on the first day which was difficult, but after that it was a breeze. I never thought I could actually go 5 days without eating, but I did.
It was a great kick-start to a get healthy program. I lost about 4kg and felt great.
I have since used it occasionally to replace meals and intend on doing the full 5-day program again to kick off the New Year.
It's really the only weight loss program that has worked for me.

testimonials.name: Nikki
story: I first heard about the Lemon Detox Diet program after hearing an ad on the radio. After checking out the website, I decided to give it a go.
I originally planned to do the 5-day detox, but after day four I started to feel really good. I got used to the taste of the drink around the third day and decided to continue for a few more days.
In the end I detoxed for 10 days and lost 7kg.
I now plan to do a weekly detox every six months.

testimonials.name: Wayne Maddren
story: I'd just like to share the results I've had.

I have completed the Lemon Detox Diet program twice in the space of four months and found it very beneficial both times. The second time I was more prepared and actually found it quite easy once day two had passed. I continued the program for 10 days.

I had been going through a recent marriage break-up and was feeling quite down, often drinking alcohol most nights. I undertook the program hoping it would help me get my life back on track — and it did.
After the first few days of feeling pretty awful, I started to experience a surge of energy. My thinking became much clearer and I felt far more positive.
Another bonus was the weight loss. I had been exercising regularly but couldn't lose the weight I wanted. After the program I lost 4–5kg and was the slimmest I had been in 17 years.
It really feels good to give your body a break from everyday food and drink and to reset your habits.
Thanks — I will continue to recommend this great and easy-to-use detox.

testimonials.name: Bob
story: I had tried several diets, exercise routines, and training programs but wasn't getting the results I needed and often felt tired after training.
With the Lemon Detox program, I felt great and lost 7kg in 10 days.
I now use it regularly as part of my routine to reset and stay on track.

testimonials.name: Frank Lucks
story: My name is Frank Lucks. Last year in January I weighed 116kg and was extremely unhappy with my appearance, health, and fitness.

I decided to try the Lemon Detox Diet program after hearing it could help reset the body, with weight loss as a positive side effect. During the program, I lost just over 10kg in one week, which became the motivation I needed to completely change my lifestyle.

During the detox, I noticed my appetite reduced significantly, allowing me to feel full with much smaller portions. I realised I had an opportunity and didn't want to waste it — so I committed to exercise and better control over my eating habits.
Today, I weigh 86kg, exercise every morning, and run 8km on weekends — not because I have to, but because I enjoy it.
My Results
• 30kg total weight loss\ • Regular daily exercise\ • Improved portion control\ • Increased energy and fitness\ • Stronger motivation and lifestyle discipline
I now have a completely renewed outlook on life. I eat what I want, just in smaller quantities, and feel better than I have in years.
People who haven't seen me for a while are always amazed and often don't recognise me. The feedback has been incredible.
I used to think testimonials sounded exaggerated, but I can genuinely say this program helped me turn my life around.

testimonials.name: Greg Mack
story: I first decided to try the Lemon Detox Diet after feeling generally unwell and tired all the time, and not having the right diet to support my lifestyle. After reviewing both the positive and negative press, I decided to give it a go.

When I started, I found it simple and easy to follow. The Lemon Drink was pleasant and gave me everything I needed throughout the day. I didn't feel hungry at all and had so much energy — it was amazing.

After 10 days, I was amazed to find that I had lost 6kg, going from 82kg to 76kg, back into a healthy weight range for my height and age. I received compliments from everyone around me about how different I looked.

The most satisfying part has been keeping the weight off. Now, 5 weeks post-program, I've maintained the results and completely changed my lifestyle. I now exercise regularly and follow a much healthier diet.
Key Changes I Experienced

• 6kg weight loss\ • Increased energy and stamina\ • Improved concentration\ • No cravings for junk food\ • Better digestion and no bloating\ • Clearer eyes and fresher breath\ • Improved circulation and reduced aches\ • Increased confidence\ • Healthier eating habits\ • Clothes fitting better
My life has changed for the better because of the Lemon Detox Diet. It has helped me reset, build better habits, and feel good about myself again.
I look forward to doing another detox later this year and making it a regular part of my life.

testimonials.name: Sharon Akkanen
story: The Lemon Detox Diet has been great for me. I use it whenever I need to lose a few kilos, and I always feel great while on it.
I still go to the gym and maintain the same energy levels, while feeling refreshed and cleansed, with no hunger at all.
I've recommended it to all my friends and would strongly suggest others give it a try.

testimonials.name: Kay Philips
story: The Lemon Detox Diet program succeeded for me where all other programs had failed.
The ability to eliminate hunger pangs while maintaining energy levels provided me with a successful formula for overall wellbeing and weight loss.
Thank you, Lemon Detox Diet!

testimonials.name: Andrea Markham
story: I am about to order my third package of Lemon Detox Diet.
I needed a kick-start to a better eating program, and Lemon Detox did exactly that. After 10 days, I felt relieved and had no hunger at all.
It gives me a stronger sense of wellbeing and the willpower to resist certain foods.
Every couple of months, I do a short detox to drop a few kilos and reset my lifestyle again. I always come off feeling lighter and rejuvenated.
It's amazing what a difference 5kg can make to how you look and feel.

testimonials.name: Stefania Marotta
story: What can I say — I loved it.
I have recommended the Lemon Detox Diet program to everyone I know, and at least 8 people have since tried it after seeing my results.
In the first 4 days, I lost 3kg and felt incredible. After a short break, I continued for another 4 days and lost a further 3kg.
My exercise routine improved, I felt more energetic, and noticeably lighter. My skin also looked clear and fresh, which was amazing.
I now try to complete the Lemon Detox program every month or so for a few days to maintain my results.
It has given me the motivation to lose weight, exercise, and be more aware of what I eat — something I had struggled with before.

testimonials.name: Matt Clark
story: I used the Lemon Detox program not really thinking it would do much — but I have to admit, the results were fantastic.
I felt more energetic, felt incredible, and it gave my body a much-needed break.
I also lost about 5kg, which was an added bonus.
I would definitely recommend it. I've already had at least 10 friends try it, and they all thought it was fantastic.
It will now be a regular part of my routine.

testimonials.name: Kathryn Johnson
story: I just finished 7 days on the detox program, lost 4.3kg, and feel so good it's hard to explain.
The first few days were a bit overwhelming not eating solid food, but each day became easier. I started to relax and felt a real sense of calm.
Whenever I felt hungry, I would have a small glass and it would instantly boost my energy.
It's the best thing I've ever done for my body. I gained so much energy and confidence, and even found myself cleaning, gardening, and staying active throughout the week.
There are so many benefits from just one week — it really is amazing.

testimonials.name: Michael Lim
story: I noticed a significant difference by day three, which was also the hardest day. After that, the rest of the 7-day detox was a breeze.
I found it easy to get out of bed, slept well, and felt lighter every morning. My skin looked clearer and my pores appeared smaller.
I also continued going to the gym and sauna during the program, which helped.
I lost 6kg during the detox and continued to lose weight even after finishing.
Three weeks later, I still feel great and naturally eat less. I definitely plan to do the Lemon Detox regularly and highly recommend it to others.

testimonials.name: Emma
story: Hi, just letting you know how I went!
I bought the 7-day package as I wanted to detox and lose some extra weight.
I started on Saturday and tracked my weight daily:
• Day 1: -2kg\ • Day 2: -1kg\ • Day 3: -0.5kg\ • Day 4: -0.5kg\ • Day 5: -1kg
I was really happy to have lost 5kg in 5 days.
I stopped at day 5 as I felt I needed some food, but I plan to continue the remaining days the following week.
It's been a great kick-start to eating healthier, and another bonus is that my skin is glowing.
I will definitely be ordering again — thumbs up!

testimonials.name: Kirsti
story: I first did the Lemon Detox Diet program before Christmas to refresh my body and mind after a stressful year of work. I wanted to feel rejuvenated, build my energy levels, and lose a little weight before a summer holiday.
I was initially nervous about how my body would react to not eating for seven days, and whether I would get bored of the taste.
To my surprise, I had no cravings for food, didn't get tired of the drink, and actually began to crave it.
After five days, I was feeling so good that I extended the program from 7 days to 10 days.
By the end, I felt energised, clear-minded, lighter, and refreshed, and lost 5kg.
I now plan to do the program four times a year as a reset, and would recommend it to anyone looking for an energy boost and renewed motivation.

testimonials.name: Jessica Smith
story: I completed a 6-day detox and felt really good.
It improved my overall wellbeing — I felt refreshed and energised after the program.
It gave me the reset I was looking for, and I now use it every couple of months to maintain my weight and continue feeling good.

testimonials.name: Wendy
story: I am a first-time user of the Lemon Detox Diet program. While I found it difficult at the beginning not eating, I felt rewarded in the end.
Although I am not overweight, I wanted to lose a few extra kilos that exercise couldn't shift to feel more confident. In the first week, I lost 3kg, which surprised me with how quickly it happened.
I found the drink refreshing and easy to have, and I still felt quite energised throughout the program.
The program is simple to prepare, and I will continue to use it regularly to maintain my weight.
I've even recommended it to my mum, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to anyone.

testimonials.name: Tia Tamapus
story: I followed the Lemon Detox Diet for one week and lost a considerable amount of weight — I was extremely happy with the results.
This is the first program I've tried that has truly worked and felt effective. The best part is that you don't feel hungry — whenever you do, you simply have another drink.
It has been easy to maintain the results, and I've introduced my sisters, their husbands, and friends to the program — they are all very happy because they can see real results.
It's very achievable, so don't stress about not eating solid foods. I highly recommend it to anyone wanting to lose weight and feel great.

testimonials.name: Janelle
story: I was feeling very flat and decided to try the Lemon Detox Diet program. I didn't think I would get through it, but after the third day, I started feeling great.
I wasn't hungry, enjoyed the taste, and noticed my skin looked better. Although I didn't weigh myself, my clothes fitted better, which was a great result.
I'll definitely be recommending it to my friends.

testimonials.name: Rebecca Fenwick
story: I have to be honest — the main reason I tried the Lemon Detox Diet program was to lose a few kilos. I felt stuck with so many different diet approaches and didn't know what to follow.
I also knew I hadn't been as healthy as usual, with more alcohol and refined foods than normal.
I completed 6 days on the program and felt fresh and revived by the end. I did feel slightly low on energy between days 2–4, but it was manageable, and I still did light gym workouts most days.
I didn't feel hungry at all and quickly got used to the taste of the drink. I even stopped craving my morning coffee.
I went from 61kg to 57kg in 6 days, which I was really happy with.
I'll definitely try to go longer next time.

testimonials.name: Maria Breis
story: I first heard about the Lemon Detox Diet on the radio. I had tried many different diets without success and was finding it hard to lose weight.
I was initially sceptical, unsure about the taste and whether it would actually work. After reading more, I decided to give it a go.
Once I started, I was surprised at how much I enjoyed the taste. It was easy to follow, I had no cravings, and I could take it with me wherever I went.
In the first 5 days, I lost 3kg, and by the end of 10 days, I had lost a total of 6.5kg.
My skin and eyes looked brighter, I had more energy, slept better, and received many compliments about how I looked.
I've recommended it to others and will continue using it as part of my healthy lifestyle.

testimonials.name: Jason
story: I first heard about the Lemon Detox Diet program on the radio and decided to try it after hearing about others who had used it successfully. My goal was to lose some extra weight and feel better in myself.
I followed the program for one week and was amazed at the results. I was able to sleep better, wake up feeling fresh and energised, and noticed fat loss across my body.
What surprised me most was that I actually felt more energetic than when eating normally. I didn't fatigue easily and had more energy for daily activities.
My concentration improved, I stayed more focused during study, and needed fewer breaks throughout the day. My complexion also improved, and I felt overall much more refreshed.
I lost 3kg, now weigh 73kg, and have maintained that weight for 2 months after completing the program.
I also find I eat less now, with smaller portion sizes, which has helped maintain my results.
I've recommended the program to friends, and several have tried it with success.

testimonials.name: Shelley Jansen
story: I first heard about the Lemon Detox program on the radio and decided to try it after reading about it online. At the time I was feeling tired, bloated, and my skin wasn't great.
On day two, I had a slight headache, but once I pushed through, everything became much easier. I didn't think about food at all, and the drink kept me satisfied throughout the day.
Even when exercising, I had plenty of energy, and what surprised me most was that I didn't feel any aches or stiffness the next day.
I completed the 7-day program and lost 3kg. After the first couple of days, I had so much energy and even grew to enjoy the taste of the drink.
I've recommended the program to at least 15 people, all of whom have had great results — from increased energy to weight loss.
It's simple, effective, and gave me more time in my day without needing to prepare food. I can't say enough about how much I enjoyed the experience.

testimonials.name: Michael Connell
story: I have just completed a 10-day detox and feel great, having lost 6kg.
After a busy Christmas and New Year period, I really needed a reset. I initially planned to do 5 days, but felt so good that I extended it to the full 10 days.
The program was simple and easy to follow, and I was never hungry. My skin improved, I lost weight, and overall I felt much better.
I will definitely be doing this every 6 months. People at work have noticed the difference, and I already know others who have started the program after seeing my results.
I would recommend starting on a weekend to get through the first couple of days — after that, it becomes very easy.
This was my first detox and I found it to be a very effective and straightforward way to reset.

testimonials.name: Jodie Slaughter
story: I first heard about the Lemon Detox program on the radio and then researched it online. After reading more, I decided to give it a go.
I believe that when you're in the right mindset, you can achieve anything — and I was in a very positive headspace when I started, which made the program easy to follow.
The drink was pleasant tasting, and I didn't feel hungry at all. I prepared it in 2-litre bottles and sipped it throughout the day, along with plenty of water.
I felt fantastic, my skin looked amazing, and people constantly commented on how great I looked — some even thought I had been on a health retreat.
I felt less bloated and continued exercising daily without any drop in energy.
I later completed the program again with my partner, and we both lost around 3–4kg.
I will definitely continue using the Lemon Detox program as I've found it to be an excellent reset.

testimonials.name: Zoran Taleski
testimonials.location: Beaumont Hills, New South Wales, Australia
story: I decided to try the Lemon Detox Diet program after hearing about it from friends. As someone who loves food, I wasn't sure how I'd go without eating for a week.
However, I can honestly say it was much easier than expected — I was never hungry during the 7 days.
The first few days I felt slightly tired, but by day three I felt a noticeable boost in energy and vitality.
Friends and family commented on how much better and more refreshed I looked.
The program did exactly what it promised — I felt cleansed, more energised, and also noticed weight loss, with others commenting on how much slimmer I looked.
I was so happy with the results that I ordered more and plan to complete a longer program.
I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a simple way to reset and improve their wellbeing.

testimonials.name: KP
story: After being on medication for a long time due to injuries, the Lemon Detox gave me new energy and made me feel more alive than I have in a long time.
Thank you.

testimonials.name: Kerryn Thompson
story: I'm happy to say I completed the Lemon Detox Diet program after 5 days. This was my third attempt, and I finally pushed through and finished it.
Unlike others, I didn't find it easy — but I'm really glad I stuck with it.
I didn't weigh myself, but I estimate I lost around 4–5kg in 5 days. I wasn't overweight to begin with, but I had gone from 45kg to 50kg over a few months and didn't feel good in myself.
After completing the program, I felt more energetic, and my skin was glowing.
The real test for me was fitting back into my favourite jeans — and I was able to put them on easily, which felt amazing.
I wanted to share my experience for anyone who might find the program challenging like I did.
My biggest tip is be prepared before you start.
Don't begin immediately — set a clear start date, plan ahead, and have a good meal the night before. This made a big difference for me.
Even though I found it challenging, I plan to continue doing the detox twice a year.
I'd also like to thank the team for their support, as well as my family and friends who helped me get through the week.
I now feel more confident and will continue working on my fitness to maintain the results.

testimonials.name: Victoria Lane
story: I had heard about the Lemon Detox program a few times on the radio and became really curious. After reading more about it, I decided to try it with a friend so we could do it together.
I was amazed at how well it went. I felt fantastic.
It wasn't easy, but it also wasn't difficult — I think being mentally prepared makes all the difference. Once you get into it, you just want to keep going.
Each time I've done the program, I've felt better than before, and I now actually look forward to doing it again and experiencing the benefits.

testimonials.name: Myquaila Carter
story: I have completed the Lemon Detox program twice. My first detox was a 10-day program, and I absolutely loved it.
After just 3 days, I felt amazing — I was sleeping better than ever, my skin was glowing, and even my hair looked great.
I had more energy, and people around me noticed the difference, which made me feel even better.
I also lost 4kg and have kept the weight off. I found I no longer craved junk food, and food tasted much better after finishing the detox.
After 10 weeks, I completed another 10-day detox and experienced the same results, losing a further 4kg.
Many of my friends have since tried the program after hearing about my experience, and I plan to continue doing it every 6 months.

testimonials.name: Michael Carlton
story: My first detox program was unbelievable. At the time, I was around 10kg overweight, drinking 6–10 cups of coffee or tea per day, and feeling miserable.
I knew something had to change, and when I heard about the Lemon Detox Diet, I decided to give it a go.
My initial goal was to cleanse my body and break my caffeine habit, but what I experienced during the 10-day program — and in the months after — far exceeded my expectations.
I lost 10kg, completely gave up caffeine, and experienced constant energy and a noticeable glow that others commented on regularly.
In fact, when I renewed my driver's licence, I was told I could keep the same photo from 5 years earlier.
If you're feeling unsure or sceptical, I encourage you to give it a try.
It can genuinely give you a new lease on life.

testimonials.name: Sally Johnson
story: Until 6 months ago, I was frustrated trying to lose weight. I had tried many different approaches without much success, and my weight had crept up to 68kg.
After hearing about the Lemon Detox from a friend, I decided to use it to reset my habits and lose weight permanently.
I now have my main meal at lunch and use the Lemon Detox Drink in the evenings — it's simple and easy to maintain.
My weight has dropped to 58kg, and even during periods like Christmas, it has been easy to manage and return to my routine.
I've reduced alcohol intake, have fewer cravings for sweets, and feel more energised.
I've even taken on new challenges — including competing in a 1km open water swim, where I placed second in my age group.
I've recommended the program to many friends, and they've also seen great results.

testimonials.name: Marion Fox
story: I have completed the Lemon Detox Diet program twice, both times for 5 days.
The first time, I was feeling run down and struggling to recover from a virus. After completing the program, I felt like a new person — I had more energy and felt better than I had in years.
The first couple of days were the hardest, but after that I improved each day.
During the program, I noticed I was smoking less, so I decided to try the detox again to help quit completely — and I did.
It has now been 2 months, and I have not had the urge to smoke.
I highly recommend the program and plan to continue doing it every 6 months.

testimonials.name: Brian Little
story: I tried the Lemon Detox Diet and found it very beneficial. I lost 14kg, going from 105kg to 91kg.
I noticed significant changes — my drinking habits stopped, I was sleeping better, eating well, and overall felt better both physically and mentally.
Exercise became more enjoyable, and I felt stronger and more motivated. Many people commented on my weight loss and how great I looked.
After some time away travelling, I fell back into old habits with eating and drinking. When I returned, I decided to use the Lemon Detox program again.
I completed a 10-day detox, going from 101kg to 94kg, and have now gone 9 weeks without alcohol.
The detox gave me the reset I needed — what you do after that is up to you, but it's a powerful way to start fresh.
This has been a great start to the year and given me a new lease on life.
I would highly recommend it — what do you have to lose?

testimonials.name: Jo B
story: I first tried the Lemon Detox program late last year and it was fantastic. The drink was satisfying and I wasn't hungry at all, even though I missed chewing food.
To my amazement, I lost well over 5kg in 7 days, broke my habit of drinking wine each night, and even noticed improvements like less sweating.
I felt great attending Christmas events and fitting into clothes I hadn't worn in years.
I now plan to do the detox every couple of months to stay on track.

testimonials.name: Janette B Maxwell Harper
story: I completed an 8-day detox and found it incredibly easy. I lost 4kg and reduced my waist by 5cm, which made me feel great.
The program helped me reset my eating habits, and I no longer feel the desire to eat unhealthy foods.
After my experience, I've introduced others to the program, and several people I know are now using it as well.

testimonials.name: L. Scott
story: Thank you — this has been a fantastic way to change my eating habits.
I used to drink soft drink constantly and eat a lot of junk food, especially after having two children. I needed a reset.
I completed a 6-day detox and, aside from a slight headache on day two, it was easier than I expected.
I now feel clean, refreshed, and have finally been able to break my caffeine habit, something I had struggled with for years.
I'll definitely be doing the program again.

testimonials.name: Karn Phaola-Or
story: I am an international student, 30 years old, and had been drinking almost every night and smoking a pack of cigarettes a day.
I completed 8 days on the Lemon Detox program and felt incredibly good. Despite not eating solid food, I still had plenty of energy while managing study and part-time work.
What surprised me most was that I no longer felt the urge to smoke the same way. It made me realise I could finally break the habit.
I lost 4kg in 8 days and felt much more refreshed and positive.
The first 3 days were the hardest, but after that it became much easier.
My friends were sceptical at first, but after seeing my results, many are now considering trying it themselves.
It has been a life-changing experience for me.

testimonials.name: Ashley Day
story: I am a 53-year-old father and recently completed the Lemon Detox Diet program.
Before starting, I felt sluggish, unmotivated, and lacked energy. I was also drinking around 8 mugs of coffee or tea per day.
I stopped caffeine before beginning the program, which caused some headaches initially, but by the end of the first day I felt empowered and committed.
Over the 7 days, I continued normal activities — cooking, attending events — and never felt tempted to eat or drink outside the program.
I felt energised, clear-headed, and better than I had in years. Even after 4 weeks, I still feel the same benefits.
I lost 4kg, particularly around my waist, and have developed a desire to eat healthier and exercise more.
I no longer drink coffee or tea and have no desire to return to it.
Several friends and family members have since started the program after seeing my results.

testimonials.name: Geri Graham
story: I have completed the Lemon Detox Diet on three separate occasions, ranging from 5 to 7 days.
My first experience was filled with doubt about adjusting to a liquid-only program. Day one was challenging, but it helped me realise how much eating is simply habit.
By day two, I felt less hungry and noticed I was drinking more water. By days 3–5, I began to feel refreshed, less sluggish, and more positive overall.
I also noticed my usual bloating had reduced, and I felt more comfortable in my clothes.
Since then, I've incorporated the program into my routine every few months. It has helped me develop healthier eating habits and better portion control after completing each detox.

testimonials.name: Julia
story: I decided to try the Lemon Detox program to support my immune system.
The experience was great — I felt wonderful both during and after the program and noticed all the benefits described.
Since completing the detox, I've found my immune system has improved, and I recover much faster when I do get unwell.
What used to leave me unwell for several days now has much less impact.
I will definitely be doing the Lemon Detox again.

testimonials.name: Josephine Schneider
story: I have a very sluggish digestive system and regularly experience constipation. I use the Lemon Detox program as a reset, and as a bonus, I also lose a few kilos.
I now complete the detox every 6 months or as needed, and it helps keep my system functioning properly while maintaining my weight.
It's a quick and easy way to kick-start your body.

testimonials.name: Melissa Zannakis
story: I am a massage therapist and personal trainer, so wellness is very important to me. I've completed the detox twice (8 months apart) and had amazing results both times.
My skin cleared within 3 days, bloating reduced, and I felt more focused and energised — without feeling hungry.
I lost nearly 4kg each time and even noticed a reduction in cellulite.
The second time, I continued my normal weights and cardio routine and maintained muscle.
I've recommended it to many people and will definitely continue using it.

testimonials.name: Kiro
story: I used the Lemon Detox for digestive issues, including indigestion and heartburn.
After one week, these problems disappeared, and I also lost 6kg, which helped kick-start further weight loss.
It's now been 3 months, and I've maintained the results with no return of symptoms.
The drink is satisfying and enjoyable, and I'll continue using it to stay on track.

testimonials.name: Jennifer Beer
story: I started using the Lemon Detox Diet about 8 months ago and loved how I felt after just 5 days.
I lost 3kg, reduced bloating, and had much more energy.
My partner also tried it and loved it, and we now both use the program regularly.

testimonials.name: Michelle Fraser
story: I found the Lemon Detox very easy to follow and more enjoyable than other detox programs I've tried.
My skin cleared, bloating disappeared, and I slept better.

testimonials.name: Shirley Mulcahy
story: I completed the Lemon Detox and lost 4kg in 5 days, but the biggest benefit was the overall feeling of wellbeing.

testimonials.name: Joseph Bechara

I now feel more alive, have reduced my reliance on medication, and have maintained my weight after 5 weeks.

testimonials.name: Donna & David Smith
story: My wife and I both used the Lemon Detox program and were extremely impressed with the results.
She lost 4kg in one week, improved her metabolism, and no longer felt bloated.
We both experienced more energy and a greater sense of wellbeing.
We now incorporate the detox regularly as part of our routine.

testimonials.name: Rosemary (Age 49)
story: I have always struggled with a slow metabolism and was sceptical about detox programs.

I also experienced better sleep, improved energy, and noticeable weight loss — confirmed by others commenting on how I looked.
My husband, who was sceptical, is now also starting the program after seeing my results.

testimonials.name: Kate Winton

Not being an overweight individual, it was always difficult for me to lean out without bulking up. I had heard of the Lemon Detox Diet before but never seriously considered it until a friend and I decided to try it together.

By the third day, I was waking up before my alarm with a completely new level of energy and motivation. I also managed to lose a couple of stubborn kilos that no other diet had been able to shift — and I had tried everything from low carb to high protein diets.
After just five days, I lost 3kg, my skin was glowing, and I felt so good that I didn't want to return to normal eating.
The physical and mental clarity I experienced during the program was incredible. I now feel more confident in myself than ever before and will definitely continue using the Lemon Detox program.

testimonials.name: Nick Bilbija

Since then, I've recommended the program to over 20 people, and the feedback has consistently been extremely positive.
This is one of the very few programs I've come across that genuinely delivers results.

testimonials.name: Sara Figueroa

testimonials.name: Cassandra Batsas

testimonials.name: Fiona Stanbury

testimonials.name: Barb Evans

testimonials.name: Belinda

testimonials.name: Darrell Barnett CMM
story: I have been using the Lemon Detox program on and off over the past few months — typically 3 days on, 3 days off — and I feel fantastic.

As someone with a busy lifestyle who used to eat out almost every night, this program has not only improved my health but has also saved me a significant amount of money.
I would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a simple, effective solution that fits into a demanding schedule.

testimonials.name: Kathleen
story: I have spent a lot of money on various diets over the years, but nothing has worked as well as the Lemon Detox program.

The program was simple, effective, and easy to follow from start to finish.
I would not hesitate to recommend it to anyone looking for real results without the usual struggles.

testimonials.name: John Bruce
story: I have been an advocate of the Lemon Detox program for over 2 years now, completing it every 4–6 months.

I can honestly say this has been some of the best money I've ever spent on my body. Not only have I experienced physical changes, but I have also saved thousands of dollars by cutting back on constant eating and drinking habits.
What started as a simple detox has completely transformed my lifestyle. I now eat less frequently, feel satisfied with smaller portions, and am far more aware of what I put into my body.
The results go far beyond weight loss. My energy levels increased, my skin improved, and I experienced a genuine sense of clarity and happiness that I hadn't felt before.
Unlike other diets I've tried, this didn't end when the program finished. It actually reset my habits long-term. Months after completing the detox, I still felt the benefits.
I used to weigh 100kg, and for the first time in over 7 years, I have maintained a weight under 85kg for the past 2 years.
I cannot praise this program enough.

testimonials.name: Trevor Smith

A friend introduced me to the Lemon Detox program after seeing great results themselves. I decided to try the 7-day program, setting myself a goal — and before I knew it, the week was complete.
I wasn't overly focused on weight loss — I simply needed a reset.

The results were incredible. Since completing the detox, I feel clear-headed, focused, and more in control than I have in a long time. My mistakes at work have disappeared, and my concentration levels have improved significantly.
In fact, I now complete my work more efficiently — what used to take 4 hours now takes closer to 3.5 hours due to improved focus.
My energy levels have also increased dramatically. I no longer feel exhausted after work.
It's honestly hard to believe such a noticeable change came from such a simple program.

testimonials.name: Daniel Martez

With a healthy diet and daily exercise, the detox gave me the kickstart and motivation I needed to completely change my body and lifestyle.
My skin is glowing, I feel significantly better overall, and I've now referred over 15 people who are currently doing the program.
I will continue doing this every year after winter — I couldn't be happier.

testimonials.name: Mr & Mrs D

testimonials.name: G V D Poll

testimonials.name: Louise Higgins

testimonials.name: Janine Telford

I've now completely stopped drinking coffee and have changed my habits long-term.
I would strongly recommend planning your start date properly and committing fully — the results are worth it.

testimonials.name: Theo
story: The Lemon Detox program was a fantastic way to reset my body and kickstart a better lifestyle. The first couple of days were tough, but after day four it became much easier.
It gave me the push I needed to start watching what I eat and live a more focused lifestyle. Three months on, I've kept most of the weight off and still feel fantastic.

testimonials.name: Lynda
story: I started with the 5-day detox program knowing I might get a headache from cutting out caffeine, so I reduced my coffee intake beforehand — which definitely helped. I still experienced a mild headache, but nothing major.
What surprised me most was how easy the program was to follow. I've tried many diets before, and this was by far one of the easiest to stick to.
I lost 5kg in 5 days, felt stronger, had more energy, and three months later I've kept the weight off.
Thank you Lemon Detox.

testimonials.name: Eva Burke
testimonials.headline: I didn't lose much at first — but the weight kept dropping and never came back.
story: I had heard a lot about the Lemon Detox program and was initially hesitant about not eating for several days. But I decided to give it a go.
The drink didn't look very appealing at first, but the taste was actually quite pleasant, and I particularly enjoyed the cayenne kick. I was also surprised that I didn't feel hungry.

I will continue using the program from time to time to maintain these results.

testimonials.name: Fiona Del Vecchio
testimonials.location: Director of Education & Training, Queensland Hair Academy

testimonials.name: Rebecca Stokes

testimonials.name: Sally Banyai

testimonials.name: Brooke Bentley
